title: IE40014: Opto-Electronics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Theory of wave optics : propagation, polarization, interference, diffraction,
transmission of light through slab and cylindrical waveguides; Optical fiber :
types, loss and dispersion characteristics; Sources : LED, gas and
semiconductor laser, Low power and high power lasers- pulsed and continuous
type; Detectors : photodiodes- PN, PIN and APD, broad band thermal detectors;
Modulation techniques: intensity, polarization, interference, electro-optic,
electromagnetic : Fiber optic components : couplers, splicer, polarizer;
Sensing techniques for displacement, pressure, acceleration, flow, current and
voltage measurement; Absorption and fluorescence measurement; Distributed fiber
optic sensors- OTDR and OFDR principles; Fiber optic gyroscope; Integrated
optics; Nonlinear optics.
